name: Gästehaus Tyrol
beschreibung:
Sunnily and conveniently located in Soell, Gaestehaus Tyrol offers cosy rooms and friendly personal attention. It provides a relaxing environment after adventurous days outdoors.

The Soell cable car base station connecting into SkiWelt and numerous hiking trails are easily reached.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Tyrol in Soell charms visitors with welcoming family hospitality by the Wilder Kaiser.
